newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO ADVANCES TO THIRD ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO ADVANCES TO THIRD ROUND.

text.p: Second seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario of Spain advanced to the third round of the Australian Open on Thursday when her opponent retired after only one game with an ankle injury.

Stephanie De Ville of Belgium, playing in her second grand slam tournament, hurt her ankle during the opening service game and was forced to retire after three minutes of play with the Spanish world number three leading 1-0.
In the quickest match of the tournament so far, only six points were played.
Sanchez Vicario, who has at reached at least the quarter-finals in her six previous attempts in Melbourne, will play either Yuka Yoshida of Japan or Belgium's Dominique van Roost in the third round.
